 Agreed Compliance Measures
 Conflict of interest screens are preventive compliance measures, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Conflict of Interest Act (Act) by a public office holder and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist public office holders in avoiding conflicts of interest. Screens also seek to minimize the possibility of conflicts arising between the public duties of the public office holder and their private interests or those of their relatives and friends.
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that a conflict of interest screen is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity to further the private interests of my friend, Ms. Ashley Bodiguel, Manager, Operations & Records at Pembina Institute, or to give preferential treatment to Pembina Institute, while I exercise my official powers, duties, and functions as a reporting public office holder.
Accordingly, I have agreed to abstain from any discussion or decision in relation to Pembina Institute. I also agree not to have any communication with government officials in relation to any matter or decision-making processes affecting Pembina Institute.
This screen is administered by the Chief of Staff to ensure that I am neither made aware of nor participate in any official matters or decision-making processes involving Pembina Institute’s private interests, unless the interest in the decision or matter is of general application. 
My minister, colleagues, and necessary public servants have been informed in writing about this conflict of interest screen.
I have undertaken to inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner at the earliest opportunity of all changes of which I become aware that relate to or should form part of the above list of matters caught by this screen.
